source_order: preserve physical array order at every level
text_normalization: none; exact JSON verse strings only
empty_text: preserve all 19 explicit empty-string verse carriers as present empty TEI ab nodes and source-accountability fields
parent_attachment: each book, chapter, and verse remains attached to its exact source parent and ordinal
source_accounting: every semantic scalar plus every ordered array boundary; explicit empty text remains distinguished by its verse node and source field record
independence: oracle independently decodes and recursively enumerates retained JSON, then inspects the actual lxml TEI tree; it does not import producer code or mapping/traversal helpers
shared_dependencies: Python UTF-8 JSON decoding and SHA-256 primitives
corroboration: compare exact retained bytes and JSON pointers with actual TEI node order, parentage, attributes, and text; source-bound hashes and explicit 39/929/23213/19 counts are independently checked
schema: TEI P5 vendored tei_all.xsd with its bound XML and TEI-X imports
downstream_segmentation: the 39 data/bible-text/jps files are read-only legacy projection evidence; they are never consumed as source or TEI authority
not_established_by_this_route: bibliographic work identity beyond the retained translation marker
textual-form or edition identity, date, contributor, or print-edition completeness
rights clearance or applicability of the repository-level MIT license to the JPS text
human acceptance, accepted IR, publication, or deployment
candidate package reproducibility or CVW visual review before coordinator handoff
